name: Search narrows a scan history to one match
looks: A search field above a scrollable list of past results types on a short query; rows that don't match thin out and collapse one by one as the characters land, leaving just a couple of rows with the matched word highlighted inside them.
build: Full list present from the start; each keystroke that changes the match set animates the newly non-matching rows out (`height -> 0`, `opacity -> 0`, 150-200ms, staggered by position). The matched substring's highlight fades in once filtering settles, not on every keystroke.
sound: A soft key-tick under the typed query, a light whoosh as rows collapse out.
prompt: Type a short query into a search field above a list of past results and let the non-matching rows thin out and collapse one by one as the characters land, highlighting the matched word inside the rows that survive once filtering settles.
